entities.summary: Kwame Governs Agbodza is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh, eight and ninth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Adaklu Constituency in the Volta Region on the ticket of the National Democratic Congress. He served as the Chief Whip in the Parliament of Ghana and currently serves as the minister in charge of Ministry of Roads and Highways (Ghana). He served as the chartered architect and a member of the Ghana Institute of Architects and royal institute of British
